name: rw_rowboat_concept

slot.where: River Walk harbour, water x 2192-2840, the two rowboats Pepper rides

subject: remove the two small brown boats at the bottom left and bottom right and paint ONE classic Stockholm wooden rowing boat (a 4 m clinker-built eka) on the water at the bottom right, seen exactly from the side, about three and a half dogs long. Its hull: warm honey-brown varnished planks, each overlapping plank a clean horizontal band with a lit top edge and a darker lower edge, a white painted top strake, a dark wooden gunwale rail, a gently curved sheer rising to a pointed bow on the left and a small square transom on the right. The water covers the bottom of the hull: the hull below the waterline is darker and bluer, with small white ripples where the hull meets the water. A friendly grown man with a white beard, a navy knitted jumper and a flat cap sits on the middle seat facing the right, both hands on the oar handles, one wooden oar dipping into the water behind him with a small splash; the oar is one straight pole with a flat blade, joined to the boat at a brass rowlock on the gunwale. The boat's gunwale is a little lower than the top of the wooden post the dog stands on, so the dog could jump down onto the boat's back seat
extra: Bright, clear summer morning colours, full local colour and crisp edges, the same flat-shaded pixel style as the dog and the post. Only the boat and the man are new; everything else in the frame stays exactly as it is.
